Read root `AGENTS.md` and `ai/manifest.md` for repository workflow and instruction scope. Select
the requested ticket stage from the root Skills catalog. The four ticket workflow adapters under
`.github/skills/` route to the canonical `ai/skills/` files; read the selected canonical file in
full and honor its stopping point. Discover applicable nested `AGENTS.md` files for affected paths
and use the root conflict procedure. Repository precedence operates within Copilot's host
instruction and security hierarchy; this file grants no tool or publication permissions.

When performing a pull request code review, use `.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` and follow the
canonical Insurance Hub workflow at `ai/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` to which it points.

When drafting or updating an existing pull request description, use
`.github/skills/pr-description/SKILL.md` and follow the canonical Insurance Hub workflow at
`ai/skills/pr-description/SKILL.md` to which it points. Modify the pull request body only when the
request explicitly asks for an update.
